objective: Implement a correct native CuTeDSL Qwen3.8 core-QSA operator and minimize the geometric-mean latency of four private step-15 fitted index draws (two CP ranks x two index seeds).

operator_contract.operation: Qwen3.8 core QSA paged BF16 sparse GQA with fused sigmoid output gate

workload_profile.note: Public fitted development cases mirror the four-shape scored step15 domain; exact scored seeds are withheld.

index_seed.note: selects one draw of the fitted step-15 index law; only legal with index_pattern='fitted_step15', step=15 and 4096 CP-local rows

invariants: logical_indices has 2051 selected-token columns plus one trailing valid-count column at the callable boundary
each non-negative selected group expands to four consecutive tokens; the 0..3-token causal tail immediately follows the group prefix
logical token -1 is padding and valid_count bounds exactly one packed non-negative prefix
K and V are views of the observed interleaved page allocation with stride [2157376,512,256,1] and V offset 65536
the scored domain uses the captured single-request block table and token mapping
24 query heads form two GQA groups of 12 heads over two KV heads
the BF16 attention result is multiplied by sigmoid(output_gate) and copied into out
index_pattern='fitted_step15' is legal only at step 15 with 4096 CP-local rows
the scored index seeds and the exact scored cases are evaluator-private

coverage_regimes.name: fitted_performance
coverage_regimes.requirement: the complete correctness and performance coverage is the same four private fitted step-15 draws (two CP ranks x two index seeds); objective is their geometric mean

coverage_regimes.name: public_performance_proxy
coverage_regimes.requirement: the two public fitted development cases are a local proxy for the timed distribution; their index seeds differ from the scored ones

production_index_summary.scope: distribution statistics of two independent step-15 CP-rank captures; exact tensors, scored index seeds and hotspot identities are withheld
production_index_summary.tokens_per_row: 2048 expanded group tokens plus a 0..3-token incomplete causal tail
production_index_summary.adjacent_intersection_at_completed_group: 478 of 512 (no extra churn at the boundary)
notes: partial cross-row overlap, page locality and persistent global hotspots are real
exact set equality and row-modulo equality are not production invariants
uniform random indices break the recency skew, the hotspot concentration and the page locality
rank1 has a valid sharp regime change in its final eight rows
